views.purpose: Decompose the system into main top-level modules and subsystems representing user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence.
required_evidence: modules or subsystems that own the task

views.purpose: Define the core architectural layers and the allowed-to-use relations and dependency directions among presentation, application, domain, and persistence layers.
Examine dependencies and interactions to ensure subsystem interfaces support future evolution and external integration replacement without violating compatibility.

notes: Selected viewpoints directly map to the architectural questions regarding system decomposition, layer dependencies, module boundaries, and subsystem interfaces for future evolution.
